title: Activity of Fluoro-Substituted 3,5-Di[(E)-Benzylidene]piperidin-4-Ones with N-Arylsulfonyl Appendages Against KRAS-Mutant Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Cells.
authors: Ghosh, Hindole; Azaz, Duha Qamar; Saxena, Addhyan; Bodenhausen, Nicole; Schobert, Rainer; Biersack, Bernhard; Dandawate, Prasad
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氟取代姜黄素类似物对KRAS突变胰腺癌细胞的抗增殖活性及STAT3抑制，属于小分子药物化学与肿瘤生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: KRAS-mutant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a high mortality that still lacks efficient therapies. Monoketone-based bisarylidene curcuminoid derivatives have shown promising activities against various PDAC models. Based on our previous findings on anticancer-active N-acryloyl-modified piperidin-4-one derivatives, we replaced the reactive acryloyl moiety by a series of N-arylsulfonyl bis-difluoro/trifluoromethylbenzylidene piperidin-4-one derivatives and tested them for antiproliferative activity against KRAS-mutant PDAC cells. Furthermore, apoptosis induction based on caspase-3/7 activation and STAT3 inhibition were investigated for the most promising compound. Notably, the N-tosyl derivative 3a with 4-trifluoromethyl substituents at the benzylidene rings exhibited the highest antiproliferative activities against PDAC cells (IC(50) = 0.22-0.26 microM, 48 h). Derivative 3a also strongly induced apoptosis in PDAC cells and suppressed STAT3 activation/phosphorylation, which was supported by molecular docking of this curcuminoid into the SH2 domain of STAT3 and by 3a-STAT3 binding confirmed using CETSA in MiaPaCa-2 cells. These findings identify compound 3a as a promising lead for further preclinical evaluation in KRAS-mutant PDAC models and in other STAT3-dependent cancer types.
abstract_zh: KRAS突变型胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）以高死亡率为特征，目前仍缺乏有效疗法。基于单酮的双亚芳基姜黄素衍生物已在多种PDAC模型中显示出有前景的活性。基于我们先前对抗癌活性N-丙烯酰基修饰的哌啶-4-酮衍生物的发现，我们将反应性丙烯酰基部分替换为一系列N-芳基磺酰基双二氟/三氟甲基亚苄基哌啶-4-酮衍生物，并测试了它们对KRAS突变型PDAC细胞的抗增殖活性。此外，对最有前景的化合物，研究了基于caspase-3/7激活的凋亡诱导及STAT3抑制。值得注意的是，在亚苄基环上带有4-三氟甲基取代基的N-甲苯磺酰基衍生物3a对PDAC细胞表现出最高的抗增殖活性（IC(50) = 0.22-0.26微摩尔，48小时）。衍生物3a还强烈诱导PDAC细胞凋亡并抑制STAT3激活/磷酸化，这通过将该姜黄素类化合物分子对接至STAT3的SH2结构域以及使用CETSA在MiaPaCa-2细胞中确认的3a-STAT3结合得到支持。这些发现将化合物3a确定为在KRAS突变型PDAC模型及其他STAT3依赖性癌症类型中进一步临床前评估的有前景的先导化合物。
